Always good to see my friend, Indian External Affairs Minister @DrSJaishankar on the sidelines of ASEAN. 

We discussed regional security issues, the Quad, trade, and defense agreements. Our relationship with India is vitally important.
posts.summary: Highlights vital U.S.-India relationship on regional security
posts.quote:

posts.text:
Was pleased to reconvene the Quad at the @ASEAN Foreign Ministers Meeting to emphasize our message: strong cooperation is vital to supporting ASEAN’s own priority and centrality in the region.  

The United States, India, Australia, and Japan share a vision of a free and open Indo-Pacific that is grounded in the rule of law, sovereignty, and territorial integrity.

The Quad remains a priority, and we will meet again later this year.
posts.summary: Strengthens Quad coalition for free and open Indo-Pacific
